newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil policeman kills three in-laws.
newsitem.headline: Brazil policeman kills three in-laws.

text.p: A Brazilian policeman enraged by his wife's decision to leave him shot dead three of his in-laws and seriously injured his wife and brother-in-law, police said on Tuesday.
Norberto Soares de Freitas, 31, then tried to commit suicide but failed and was arrested, a police spokeswoman said.

She said Freitas shot and killed his mother-in-law, sister-in-law and 12-year-old niece with a handgun as they slept early on Monday in their home in Sete Lagoas, 60 miles (100 km) from Belo Horizonte in the southeastern state of Minas Gerais.

The spokeswoman said he shot his wife, Maria Helena Soares, in the chest and his brother-in-law in the stomach before trying to commit suicide by slashing his wrists. Soares and her brother were recovering in a hospital, she said.
Police believe Freitas could not cope with the fact that his wife left him a week earlier to live with her mother and wanted to separate from him.
